run_pulsar_renderer: run the pulsar sphere renderer to render 10 random spheres and save basic.png
create_renderer_instance: create a pulsar Renderer with width, height, n_points, and right_handed_system config
render_spheres: render spheres by calling the Renderer with positions, colors, radii, camera params, gamma, and max depth
configure_camera_params: configure camera parameters tensor with position, rotation, focal length, and sensor size
save_rendered_image: save the rendered tensor image to a PNG file using imageio.imsave
